extra.floor_runs: repeat: a second process at 4 threads; threads1: one process at 1 thread; ulp: 4 threads with every atom coordinate nudged one ulp up (WPX_ULP=1)

notes.BasisGradient.evaluate: (function, axis, point) complex; perturbed: points moved by 0.01 Bohr in x. Rows 44 and 45 are the two nuclei, 46 is 1e-13 Bohr away (nucleus branch), 47 is beyond every cutoff (zero)
notes.radial_slope: (function, r); perturbed: r scaled by 1+1e-6 (rows are the basis functions in crystal order)
notes.short_range_cross.even_odd.atom0: (k, even rows, odd cols); perturbed: every k shifted by 0.01 Bohr^-1 along (1,1,1)
notes.remainder_transforms.atom0: (a, b, vector) complex; perturbed: the atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr (a phase exp(-i g.d))
notes.onsite_remainder.atom0: (a, b, c, d) Hartree; perturbed: indices (a,c,b,d) (a wrong pair convention)
notes.projector_lm: (P, 4): atom, l, m, radial index of every projector in crystal order (T0 exact)
notes.ion_constants_gradient: one atom: zero by translation invariance; no perturbation exists
notes.ion_constants: Ha, the sum whose derivative is frozen; perturbed: the last atom moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr
notes.short_range_ion_compensation_gradient: (channel, atom, axis) complex per Bohr, channels sorted as in inputs.sr_channels; perturbed as above
notes.short_range_ion_compensation: (channel) complex, the sum whose derivative is frozen; perturbed as ion_constants
notes.local_potential_derivative: Ha/Bohr, dataset 0 (the slope short_range_potential_derivative is built from); perturbed: r scaled by 1+1e-6
notes.density.rho: (grid) real, symmetrized like the SCF density; perturbed: P scaled by 1.001
notes.density.q: (channel) complex multipoles, rotated by the operations
notes.kinetic_energy_density: (grid) real tau = 1/2 sum w P grad.grad*, symmetrized
notes.moment_operator: (P, P) complex = sum_c w_c blk_c on each atom's projector block; perturbed: w scaled by 1.001
notes.moment_traces: (channel) complex tr(R_AA blk_c); perturbed: R scaled by 1.001
notes.bloch_gradients: (axis, mu, grid) complex at the first k-point; perturbed: k shifted by 0.01 Bohr^-1 along (1,1,1)
notes.bloch_sums: (1, mu, grid) complex at one generic k; perturbed: k shifted by 0.01
notes.projections: (k, mu, p) complex <chi_k|p~>; perturbed as above
notes.magnetization: (3, grid) real (mx, my, mz) of spinor P_k (2M x 2M, alpha first) on the full mesh
notes.spinor_kinetic_energy_density.tau: (grid) real trace of the spinor tau matrix (UNPORTED)
notes.dense_compensation.shift0: (channel, channel) complex; perturbed: the shift moved by 0.01 Bohr^-1 (UNPORTED)
notes.dense_compensation.shift1: (channel, channel) complex; perturbed: the shift moved by 0.01 Bohr^-1 (UNPORTED)
notes.place_core.atom0: (grid) real, the atom's xc core placed with its images; perturbed: center moved by (0.02,-0.01,0.015) Bohr
notes.valence_shares: (atom, grid) real n_A / sum_B n_B, zero where the sum is (UNPORTED)
notes.local_split_width: sigma in Bohr (the native split width)

notes.mesh_wedge.0.time_reversal.mapping: (nk) wedge index of each mesh point

BasisGradient.fd_abs.note: central difference of parent.evaluate, step 1e-05 Bohr, 540 points away from the nucleus

BasisGradient.nucleus_p0_analytic.note: d_z(R'(0) r Y_10) = R'(0) sqrt(3/4pi) at the nucleus

BasisGradient.s_nucleus_max.note: an s function has no gradient at its own nucleus

radial_slope.fd_abs.note: central difference of function.radial, step 1e-06 Bohr, breakpoints excluded

short_range_cross.im_over_max.atom0.note: non-vacuity: the generic k makes the array complex (a wrong k.R sign changes it)

short_range_cross.translation_fd_abs.ato.note: -(G + G^H) against the central difference (step 0.0001 Bohr) of the matrix with every basis center shifted and the sphere fixed

remainder_transforms.hermitian.atom0.note: E_ab(g) = conj(E_ba(-g)); the gate of test_it_is_hermitian_in_the_pair

remainder_transforms.g0_over_max.atom0.note: the remainder carries no net charge: E(0) is small against the rest

remainder_transforms.table_step_error.note: relative to the maximum: step 0.025 against a table four times finer (interpolation error)

onsite_remainder.pair_exchange.atom0.note: pair-exchange asymmetry, relative; a property of the quadrature (5e-5 measured), not roundoff: do not tighten

short_range_ion_compensation_gradient.fd.note: per Bohr, step 1e-4 Bohr, every atom and axis

kinetic_energy_density.integral_vs_kinet.note: relative: int tau = sum_k w tr(P T_k) with the kinetic matrix of _kinetic; int tau = 1.55847

kinetic_energy_density.min.note: minus the minimum: tau is nonnegative for a PSD P

bloch_gradients.kinetic_matrix.note: relative: 1/2 <grad chi_m|grad chi_n> = _kinetic[m, n]; the gap is the alias mean of |G+k|^2 against the square of the mean G+k

bloch_sums.psi_difference.note: the first k-point of the crystal is KPoint.psi: exact (not stored: the setup freeze holds psi)

bloch_sums.image_sum.note: relative: the plain sum over lattice images of exp(i k.R) chi(r - R) at 40 grid points (the test of bloch_values), independent of the C/Rust kernel

bloch_sums.im_over_max.note: non-vacuity: a generic k makes the Bloch sums complex

projections.kpoint_difference.note: the first k-point is KPoint.projections (the (M, P) block the crystal stores)

magnetization.pauli_trace.note: m_a = tr(rho sigma_a) with explicit Pauli matrices; array maximum 0.05196

magnetization.collinear_limit.note: P = diag(Pa, Pb): mz = rho(Pa) - rho(Pb), mx = my = 0

spinor_kinetic_energy_density.collinear_.note: P = diag(Pa, Pb): tau = tau(Pa) + tau(Pb), tau_z = tau(Pa) - tau(Pb), tau_x = tau_y = 0

dense_compensation_gradient.fd_abs.note: per Bohr; dU/dR_A = grad (delta_aA - delta_bA), A = atom 0, step 0.0001

valence_shares.sum_to_one.note: exact: the shares of a point sum to 1

short_range_cross.gradient_bra: BasisGradient(basis[mu], axis) at index axis*M + mu; ket = the M basis functions

remainder_table.note: linear interpolation; vectors 0 and 3,4 sit on table nodes, the largest random vectors are past the table end

dense_compensation.kernel: screened, omega = 0.11 Bohr^-1: 4 pi (1 - exp(-q2 / 4 omega^2)) / q2, pi / omega^2 at q = 0

mesh_wedge_refusal.message: the k-point mesh is not symmetric under k -> -k
